method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
Equities.summary: CoreWeave's stock has been hammered heading into the neocloud's Q3 earnings report.
Equities.reason: Company-level beat + raised guidance signals continued strength in AI/cloud demand, reinforcing the market narrative that AI revenue growth is holding up and supporting risk appetite for AI/semiconductor-related equities.

Equities.title: CoreWeave beats quarterly revenue estimates as AI demand defies growing doubts
Equities.reason: Independent confirmation from a major wire that CoreWeave beat reinforces the AI demand narrative but is a repeat signal so assigned lower relevance.

Equities.title: Nvidia selloff deepens, adding to AI jitters
Equities.reason: Widening NVDA sell-off directly amplifies market-wide AI risk narrative and triggers broader tech/market volatility; high relevance because Nvidia is a market leadership anchor for the AI trade.

Equities.title: Nvidia hires former US prosecutor at Wachtell to lead Jensen Huang probe
Equities.summary: Former acting head of US attorney’s office for Southern District of New York tapped for investigation of CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
Equities.reason: Escalation of legal/PR risk around Nvidia's CEO raises uncertainty over leadership continuity and potential regulatory/political fallout, weighing on investor confidence in the AI leadership complex.

Equities.title: Nvidia’s Bull Case Hinges on CEO Huang Surviving China Spy Probe
Equities.reason: Analytical piece tying Nvidia's valuation case to CEO-related geopolitical/legal risk increases downside for broad AI sector and investor positioning; significant because it questions the core bullish thesis for the market's largest AI proxy.

Equities.title: Investors pivot to defensive stocks as markets enter a ‘state of alert’
Equities.summary: Technology stocks have lost momentum while defensive sectors gain ground, as investors reassess risks.
Equities.reason: Shows a tactical shift in positioning away from growth/AI names toward defensives — a market breadth signal indicating increased risk aversion and potential rotation pressure on cyclicals/tech.

Equities.title: Anthropic bankers prepare to increase IPO valuation to $1.5tn or more
Equities.summary: Claude maker’s listing price expected to rise after strong demand from investors
Equities.reason: Robust demand and higher IPO sizing for a major AI company point to continued investor appetite for AI exposure, supporting broader risk-on flows within the technology/AI leadership theme.

Equities.title: Hedge Fund Risk Retreat Largest in a Decade, Morgan Stanley Says
Equities.reason: Institutional risk reduction (large hedge fund de-risking) is a cross-market flow that supports defensive rotation and can amplify volatility in high-beta/dispersion trades.

Equities.title: AI Debt Blowups Become Fodder for ETFs Aimed at Retail Investors
Equities.reason: Highlighting structural risks in AI-related leverage and productization that could increase volatility and hurt crowded equity strategies; lower relevance as it's a niche product-risk signal rather than broad macro.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Hot CPI lifts yields and Fed bets – Rabobank
Rates.summary: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team highlights that hotter-than-expected US CPI has pushed US 2-year and 10-year yields sharply higher, reviving talk of a possible 50 bps Federal Reserve hike. The report links the move to renewed inflation
Rates.reason: Direct note that hotter-than-expected US CPI pushed 2y and 10y yields sharply higher and revived 50bp Fed talk — clear negative for bond prices with high relevance to rates markets.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield races back to 5% as inflation data, Waller comments drive rate hike expectations
Rates.summary: Treasury yields moved higher after a hotter-than-expected CPI report.
Rates.reason: Reports 10-year yield hitting ~5% following hot CPI and Fed commentary — very strong signal of bond selloff and materially higher terminal rate expectations, high relevance.

Rates.title: US yields climb, stocks fall as inflation data boosts chances for larger Fed rate hike
Rates.reason: Market wrap highlights yields rising and equity weakness after hotter inflation — reinforces a broad yields-up, hike-risk market regime; high relevance.

Rates.title: Fed policy: December hike seen sealed with 50bps risk – TD Securities
Rates.summary: TD Securities’ macro research team argues that the upside US CPI surprise and firm Core PCE projections make a December Fed rate hike virtually certain. They still favor a 25bp move but see rising odds of an additional hike in early 2027 and consider a 50bp “c
Rates.reason: Research note explicitly moves up probability of December hike and 50bp risk — pushes policy path tighter and is directly rate-relevant.

Rates.title: Japan Government Bond Yields Jump, Tracking Treasury Selloff
Rates.reason: JGB yields rising in lock-step with US Treasury selloff — shows cross-market transmission of US-driven global rate repricing, relevant to global rates positioning.

Rates.title: Asian Bond Yields Rise on Growing Expectations for Fed Rate Hike
Rates.reason: Regional bond yields climbing as Fed hike odds increase — supports the dominant narrative of global rate repricing from US inflation surprise.

Rates.title: Traders Who Rushed to Safety of Bonds Get Rattled in Reversal
Rates.reason: Coverage of a sudden reversal from safe-haven bids into a selloff — indicates liquidity/positioning risks and amplification of the yields-up move; directly rates-relevant.

Rates.title: TRADING DAY US rate outlook trumps everything
Rates.reason: Commentary that US rate outlook is the dominant driver of markets today — aligns with elevated importance of rates in price discovery and risk pricing.

Rates.title: Fed’s Goolsbee: CPI was borderline disturbing on inflation
Rates.summary: Speaking in an interview on PBS Newshour early Wednesday, Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee said that “CPI was borderline disturbing on inflation.”
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official characterizing CPI as worrying — hawkish tone increases odds of further tightening, modestly rate-negative.

Rates.title: Fed’s Paulson: Further ‘gradual’ rate hikes appropriate given high inflation
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank of Philadelphia Governor Anna Paulson delivered a speech at the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia's 81st Annual Field Meeting Capstone.
Rates.reason: Local Fed governor endorses further rate hikes given high inflation — reinforces policy-tightening bias and is rate-relevant.

Rates.title: Fed’s Bowman warns CPI signals persistent US inflation pressures
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Michelle Bowman said that “bringing inflation down remains a priority,” and that “CPI data suggests inflation pressures may persist.”
Rates.reason: Another Fed official warning that CPI points to persistent inflation — adds to the consensus for more restrictive policy and higher yields.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar declines despite higher oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD remains stronger for the second successive day, trading around 1.4190 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) remains stronger following the latest inflation report, which cemented market expectations for a Federal
FX.reason: USD-led move: article links USD/CAD strength directly to US inflation-driven Fed expectations. USD strength is the dominant FX narrative and weighs on CAD; high relevance for USD/CAD given commodity (oil) context but USD is the driver.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index steadies on Fed rate-hike odds
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining steady after registering over 0.5% gains in the previous day and trading around 102.20 during Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: DXY is the central FX barometer: sustained upside on Fed rate-hike odds signals broad USD strength, which is negative for FX asset-class (USD appreciation dominates cross moves). High relevance as a market-wide indicator.

FX.title: Yen nears 159.00 with Treasuries back above 5%
FX.summary: New US 10-year notes sold on Tuesday pay 5% a year, the most since 2006, and the Yen has dropped to its weakest against the Dollar since mid-October. The Dollar rose to just under 159.00 Yen, more than reversing Monday's drop and moving back above Friday's clo
FX.reason: Yield-driven USD strength: higher US Treasury yields are lifting the USD and pushing USD/JPY higher. This is a key cross affected by global yield moves and a salient example of USD-dominant pressure on FX.

FX.title: Euro drifts toward the bottom of its range as US rate bets climb
FX.summary: Five weeks into a 1.1100-1.1300 range, the Euro is still inside it after US consumer prices beat forecasts, though back in the lower half. It dropped to just below 1.1150, giving back nearly all of Monday's climb, and has edged back above that level.
FX.reason: EUR underperformed after stronger US CPI/ rate bets: article highlights EURUSD sliding toward lower range as USD gains — reinforces the dominant USD-strength narrative affecting major pairs.

FX.title: ECB’s Lane warns underlying inflation may rise as energy prices fall
FX.summary: The European Central Bank (ECB) Chief Economist Philip Lane said that “it would be a surprise if there are no second-round effects,” and that if energy prices edge lower, “headline inflation could fall while underlying inflation rises,” he said at the Bank of
FX.reason: ECB commentary matters for EUR: Lane's warning implies sticky core inflation and less scope for easing, which is a hawkish signal for the euro relative to USD — a counterweight to USD-driven weakness and relevant for EURUSD positioning.

FX.title: Indian Rupee extends rally amid continued FIIs buying, lower oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) continues to outperform the US Dollar (USD) on the back of significant inflow of foreign funds into the Indian stock market and a continued decline in oil prices. In the opening trade, the USD/INR pair posts a fresh five-month low near 9
FX.reason: Local flow-driven INR strength: FII inflows and lower oil are supporting INR, which represents a localized USD-weakness signal. Relevant for EMFX moves and USD liquidity considerations, though more idiosyncratic than G10 moves.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens amid domestic political instability, stable US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after registering modest losses the previous day, trading around 18,140 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair advanced as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) came under pressure from heightened market caution following political insta
FX.reason: Idiosyncratic EM risk: IDR weakness is driven by domestic political instability rather than a generalized USD surge. Relevant for EMFX risk mapping but lower relevance than broad USD/yield stories.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar strengthens despite decreasing RBNZ rate hike odds
FX.summary: NZD/USD inches higher after posting over 0.5% losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5600 during Asian hours on Wednesday. However, the upside for the currency pair could remain capped as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) faces potential headwinds.
FX.reason: Mixed-central-bank signal but NZD bid: NZD strength despite falling RBNZ hike odds points to localized flows/risk sentiment supporting antipodeans. Relevant but lower-impact vs. major USD/yield-driven moves.

Commodities.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
Commodities.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields
Commodities.reason: Refiners shifting output toward middle distillates (diesel/jet) supports distillate prices and signals a structural tightening in that segment of the oil product complex; also alters gasoline/distillate balance which is market-relevant for fuel curves.

Commodities.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
Commodities.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million
Commodities.reason: A large, conflict-driven drop in refinery throughput tightened product markets in 2Q26 (supportive for crude and refined product prices); the subsequent partial recovery is noted but the initial shock remains market-relevant.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
Commodities.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. imports from Venezuela add incremental crude supply to the market and can ease near-term tightness in the Americas, exerting modest downward pressure on crude prices.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Near-term Gulf Coast production and logistical shut-ins from a hurricane tend to tighten regional supply and support crude and gasoline prices while the storm impacts persist.

Commodities.title: WTI rebounds above $85.50 despite easing Middle East tensions
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground after two days of losses, trading around $85.60 per barrel during Asian hours on Wednesday. However, crude oil prices may depreciate following signs of easing tensions between the US and Iran.
Commodities.reason: Price rebound signals resilience in crude markets even as geopolitical risk shows signs of easing; near-term supportive but mixed signal given potential de-risking.

Commodities.title: China’s Copper Crunch Puts Industry on Defensive as Costs Soar
Commodities.reason: A pronounced copper supply/cost squeeze in China is a material bullish fundamental for copper prices and signals stress across industrial metals; large relevance given China's central role in demand and processing.

Commodities.title: India's gold ETF inflows drop 22% in October as fund houses halt bulk subscriptions
Commodities.reason: A notable slowdown in one of the world's largest physical and ETF demand centers (India) points to weaker near-term gold demand and is moderately negative for gold prices.

Commodities.title: Gold edges higher after sharp selloff, Fed hike bets weigh
Commodities.reason: Short-term price rebound in gold after a selloff, but upside capped by rate-hike expectations and USD strength—small net positive short-term price action with policy headwinds.

Commodities.title: Singapore wants a bigger slice of the global gold market. Is it too late to the party?
Commodities.summary: Singapore is stepping up efforts to become a key player in the global gold market, betting that vaulting service and tax incentives will help it attract flows.
Commodities.reason: Policy and infrastructure moves to attract gold flows to Singapore improve market liquidity/venue competition but are a low-impact structural story for physical gold demand/prices in the near term.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
Crypto.reason: ETF outflows and institutional selling are direct negative demand shocks for BTC; reinforces a risk-off, liquidity-driven narrative across crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
Crypto.reason: Large miner liquidation materially increases supply into the market and pressures prices; high relevance to BTC market microstructure and short-term sentiment.

Crypto.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
Crypto.reason: Macro inflation surprise increases Fed tightening expectations and risk-off flows, a negative cyclical driver for risk assets including BTC and large-cap crypto.

Crypto.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
Crypto.reason: Persistent large-scale illicit use and creative laundering via memecoins raises regulatory scrutiny and reputational risk for crypto infrastructure and exchanges.

Crypto.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
Crypto.reason: Major institutional adoption signal: NYSE choosing Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks materially supports onchain institutional use-cases and infrastructure demand.

Crypto.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
Crypto.reason: Broader tokenization and asset-backed finance adoption—Securitize expanding into large legacy markets is a constructive institutional-adoption narrative for crypto rails.

Crypto.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
Crypto.reason: Regulatory-approved rails for tokenizing regulated U.S. assets support onchain liquidity and institutional flows—positive for crypto infrastructure adoption.

Crypto.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
Crypto.reason: Cooperation with U.S. government in legal cases may signal constructive regulatory engagement and potential clarity for derivatives, modestly positive for institutionalization.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level security upgrade enhances XRP Ledger's technical positioning and long-term viability; small positive for that network's adoption case.
